The Kubernetes teams make running MongoDB in and from Kubernetes so frictionless that it is the default database choice for cloud-native applications. Our operators let developers and platform teams provision, scale and operate MongoDB through Kubernetes-native APIs, in their own clusters or in MongoDB Atlas.

You will join the Kubernetes Capabilities squad. Our sister squad builds the shared platform layer of the MongoDB Controllers for Kubernetes; we build the capabilities on top of it that users actually adopt. That means bringing MongoDB features such as Search and Vector Search to Kubernetes, extending what our users can deploy and manage declaratively, and owning the Atlas Kubernetes Operator. Our work starts with a user problem and ends with a Kubernetes API that solves it.

In practice, we build a platform for other engineers. Our users are developers and platform teams who expect self-service, sensible defaults and APIs that behave predictably. If you have built an internal developer platform, a Kubernetes controller, or any system whose customers are other engineers, you will recognise the problems we work on.

No prior experience with MongoDB is required. You will meet most of the team during interviews, and we pride ourselves on being an inclusive, collaborative group that Builds Together. Our core engineering values are Context, Predictability, Transparency, Focus and Craftsmanship.

  • Shape our platform APIs with our users in mind: predictable, self-service and safe to operate
  • Mentor engineers through pairing, code review and design feedback

Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

Application Platform is part of Product Platform within Figma’s Infrastructure organization. We build shared foundations that help engineers ship backend product work quickly, safely, and reliably. The team owns a large Ruby application that powers Figma’s REST APIs, asynchronous jobs, and workflow orchestration. Our systems sit on critical production paths and shape the day-to-day experience of backend engineers across Figma.

We’re looking for an experienced backend engineer with meaningful production Ruby experience who enjoys building for other engineers. You don’t need to be a Ruby language specialist. You should be comfortable making informed tradeoffs in a substantial shared codebase and turning recurring problems into durable systems, tools, and paved paths that improve engineering velocity across the company.

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States. 

What you'll do at Figma:

  • Design and evolve shared Ruby frameworks for REST APIs, asynchronous jobs, workflow orchestration, and data access
  • Improve the availability, reliability, scalability, and performance of backend systems that support critical product functionality
  • Modernize a large Ruby codebase through safe architectural changes, including moving REST APIs from Sinatra toward Rails and introducing stronger endpoint abstractions and type safety
  • Make backend development faster by improving hot reloading, local workflows, test infrastructure, CI reliability, debugging tools, and iteration speed
  • Strengthen the scalability, isolation, observability, and recovery capabilities of Figma’s asynchronous job platform
  • Partner with product engineers—your customers—and Infrastructure teams to identify recurring pain points and turn them into reusable platform capabilities

  • Mentor other engineers and contribute to a culture of thoughtful execution, high technical standards, and shared ownership

  • Improve complex, established systems through architecture, modularization, migrations, performance, reliability, or developer tooling
  • Create scalable abstractions, navigate technical tradeoffs, and collaborate with and mentor engineers across teams

  • Build or operate background-job and workflow systems, with an understanding of concepts such as retries, idempotency, scheduling, backpressure, isolation, or failure recovery
  • Work with cloud and infrastructure technologies such as AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, or workflow systems like Temporal

title: Software Engineer, Ad Signals
description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

We are seeking a senior backend software engineer to help build the app conversion signals that power Reddit’s app advertising business. You will work on MMP integrations, SKAN processing, and App CAPI to make app installs and in-app events more reliable, useful, and easier for advertisers to integrate.

Role Description:

Advertisers depend on conversion signals to understand campaign performance and guide investment. Missing events, duplicate delivery, inconsistent mappings, and difficult integrations can undermine that trust. Your work will improve the systems and diagnostics that make app signals usable for measurement and downstream ads systems.

Responsibilities:

  • Own backend projects across MMP, SKAN, and App CAPI, from requirements and design to implementation, rollout, and ongoing operation.
  • Build scalable ingestion and processing services with clear contracts, validation, deduplication, failure recovery, and data lineage.
  • Develop integration tooling and diagnostics that help advertisers and partners identify and resolve signal delivery problems.
  • Analyze signal quality and delivery metrics, investigate discrepancies, and prioritize improvements with product and data science partners.
  • Work with partner engineering and downstream consumers to evolve schemas and integrations without disrupting existing advertisers.
  • Incorporate privacy and security requirements into system design, and maintain controls throughout the data lifecycle.
